summary: Join our Community-Based Resource Management Training Course to gain essential skills for managing resources sustainably and empowering your community.
lede: Community-based resource management helps development professionals and local stakeholders involve communities in governing shared resources. The course covers assessing local needs and resource users, designing inclusive decision-making structures, and resolving disputes through negotiation and dialogue. It also explores sustainable livelihood planning and community-led monitoring of resource management plans.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals and stakeholders driving or supporting community-based development.
audience: Donor and program officers in sustainable development
Policy makers in natural resource governance
Social scientists, researchers, and consultants in participatory
modules: Principles of Sustainable Natural Resource Management
Integrating Traditional Knowledge and Modern Tools
Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning (MEL) in CBRM
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of community development and resource management principles. Experience in rural development or environmental management is beneficial but not required.
